note: Every Minecraft version, by era: the Java it runs on, the loaders a mod can target (eras/loaders.json names each loader's packages), how its code is named, and the walls a port crosses. Read by the Gradle plugin (mycelium { minecraft = ... }): a target's era sets its Java, its era gate and its evidence. Ordered newest first; from and to are inclusive, and each is a version as Mojang's launcher manifest names it (eras/versions.json) or a whole line, '<line>.x' (every version of that line, those still to come included). The repository check proves every real version falls in exactly one era. Each row's facts are re-verified against the loaders' own mavens when a consumer first ports to it (docs/eras.md).
